recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-16476; future ChargeItem/ChargeItemDefinition changes should be made in the admin-incubator source rather than by restoring removed core resource files.
issue_request: FHIR-16476 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It asked to split ChargeItem.definition into ChargeItem.definitionUri for external URI definitions and ChargeItem.definitionCanonical targeting ChargeItemDefinition, while moving the proposed ChargeItemDefinition $apply operation to a separate tracker.
initial_application: The change was applied by d17a0d20d94c0a3dcd320f9f8272bc5cd5559799, titled "GF#16476: split ChargeItem.definition into definitionUri and definitionCanonical". That commit updated the ChargeItem example and spreadsheet, and the generated ChargeItem StructureDefinition before later removal had definitionUri and definitionCanonical with definitionCanonical targeting ChargeItemDefinition.
additional_context: Patient Administration 2018 Baltimore WGM minutes record the same narrowed motion and vote, and a PA Zulip thread shows the request to apply GF#16476 immediately before the implementation commit. In the current core branch, ChargeItem and ChargeItemDefinition are absent from active source/fhir.ini resource lists and their source directories were deleted by 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36, which moved immature resources to incubator IGs and rewired current core narrative links to HL7 admin-incubator ChargeItem and ChargeItemDefinition pages.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR core source change is appropriate because the current core build no longer owns an authoritative ChargeItem resource source, and the current admin-incubator ChargeItem artifact already has definitionUri and definitionCanonical with the canonical targetProfile set to ChargeItemDefinition.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification request to split ChargeItem.definition into definitionUri and definitionCanonical(ChargeItemDefinition), while deferring the apply operation.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final request and confirms that the operation work was outside this issue's applied scope.

evidence_items.summary: Minutes record the motion to update ChargeItem.definition to support ChargeItem.definitionCanonical(ChargeItemDefinition) and ChargeItem.definitionUri with a 2-0-2 vote.
evidence_items.learned: This confirms the work-group decision and the same narrowed scope as the Jira resolution.

evidence_items.locator: #patient administration WG > R4 Changes being applied
evidence_items.summary: Brian Postlethwaite asked Simone Heckmann to apply GF#16476 on 2018-10-28 and Simone replied that she was on it on 2018-10-29.
evidence_items.learned: This supports the implementation timing immediately before the source commit.

evidence_items.summary: Commit titled GF#16476: split ChargeItem.definition into definitionUri and definitionCanonical changed the ChargeItem example and spreadsheet.
evidence_items.learned: The requested split was applied in core source before this reconciliation.

evidence_items.summary: Before removal from core, ChargeItem contained definitionUri and definitionCanonical, with definitionCanonical targeting ChargeItemDefinition.
evidence_items.learned: The generated StructureDefinition surface matched the Jira request while ChargeItem was still in core.

evidence_items.summary: The removal commit deleted source/chargeitem and source/chargeitemdefinition, removed ChargeItem and ChargeItemDefinition from source/fhir.ini resource lists, and added current links to admin-incubator artifacts.
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative ChargeItem source is outside the current FHIR core checkout/build.

evidence_items.summary: The current moved ChargeItem artifact has definitionUri and definitionCanonical, and definitionCanonical targets http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/ChargeItemDefinition.
evidence_items.learned: The external artifact preserves the FHIR-16476 split, so there is no core source correction to make.

evidence_items.summary: No existing combined-branch audit commit was found before publishing, and no current core source text uses stale ChargeItem.definition wording without Uri or Canonical.
evidence_items.learned: A single empty audit commit is appropriate and no current core text contradicts the applied split.
